annotation_notes.outcome: SUCCESS only when both toys finish fully and stably inside a basket. Either toy may be placed in either the left or right basket.
annotation_notes.valid_placement: IN_LEFT_BASKET and IN_RIGHT_BASKET are both valid final states for either toy. Basket assignment does not depend on the toy's initial side or the robot arm used.
annotation_notes.failure_detected: YES when at least one visible failure occurs. Normal approach, grasping in progress, transport in progress, and placing a toy into either basket are not failures.
annotation_notes.first_failure_time_s: Earliest timestamp at which the first failure becomes visually observable. Use null for a rollout with no failure.
annotation_notes.failure_type: Primary or first failure type. Keep this field for compatibility with the current evaluation script.
annotation_notes.failed_side: LEFT, RIGHT, BOTH, or NONE. Side refers to the toy's initial side, not the basket in which it is placed. Use BOTH when separate failures affect both toys.
annotation_notes.left_toy_final_state: ON_TABLE, HELD, IN_BASKET, ON_BASKET_EDGE, NOT_VISIBLE, or UNCERTAIN.
annotation_notes.right_toy_final_state: ON_TABLE, HELD, IN_BASKET, ON_BASKET_EDGE, NOT_VISIBLE, or UNCERTAIN.
annotation_notes.failure_events: List every temporally distinct failure in chronological order. For a rollout with no failure, use an empty list [].
annotation_notes.failure_event_side: LEFT, RIGHT, or BOTH. Side refers to the toy's initial side.
annotation_notes.failure_event_type: NONE, LEFT_GRASP_MISS, RIGHT_GRASP_MISS, BOTH_GRASP_MISS, LEFT_OBJECT_DROP, RIGHT_OBJECT_DROP, BOTH_OBJECT_DROP, OBJECT_OUTSIDE_BASKET, BIMANUAL_DESYNCHRONIZATION, COLLISION, NO_PROGRESS, or OTHER.
annotation_notes.recovery_action_reference: Optional human reference action that places every unplaced toy fully inside either available basket.
annotation_notes.recovery_exit_condition_reference: Both toys are fully and stably inside a basket; either basket is valid for either toy.
